dorsal_wing_plumage_topography.flight_feather_edge_geometry: Prominent and sharp boundary; broad pale grey edges contrast strongly with dark feather centers on folded secondaries and primaries.

crown_and_nape_macro_patterns.crown_to_mantle_demarcation: Low distinctness; a non-linear, gradual transition from dense longitudinal streaking on the crown to broad scalloping on the mantle.

other_distinctive_markers: Highly repetitive, high-contrast scalloped pattern across the entire dorsal region caused by dark subterminal centers and wide, pale terminal fringes.
